title: KR Defense/Core_Secondary single-sleeve long-only top-20 signal-portfolio translation 구조적 실패
judge_cascade_trigger: Gate 14 AX_CAND 3rd member screening PASS (STR_1687 L-166이 3rd member slot 충족)
statement_draft: KR market에서 defense 또는 core_secondary single-sleeve long-only top-20 전략은 signal level ICIR이 강함(0.5+ 또는 t>2.0)에도 portfolio level top-20 long-only translation이 구조적으로 실패한다. 4가지 structural cause: (1) top-20 concentration 위험 누적, (2) idio volatility tight clustering, (3) hedging 부재 — long-only 구조에서 negative beta 활용 불가, (4) positive ICIR과 drawdown causal 연결 부재. EXCLUSION clause(sector-neutralized/multi-sleeve 2/4 필요조건만 만족)로는 회피 불가 — long-short 또는 50+ 분산이 empirical threshold.

exclusion_clause.multi_sleeve_blend: 전체 multi-sleeve portfolio 내 sleeve 구성 요소 (STR_1679v3 Core+Def blend pattern 참조)
exclusion_clause.long_short_structure: long-short 구조로 hedging 가능 시 scope 밖
exclusion_clause.diversified_50_plus: 50종목+ 분산 universe 시 scope 밖 (empirical threshold, 추후 보정 가능)

supporting_l_codes.signature: Multi-source 4-axis defense anchor ICIR 0.74~0.94 / MDD 77.21~94.69% (4 variants)
Q07 sector-neutral 2-axis (Q07+SUE) ICIR high / MDD 58.67% / SR 0.565 / Worst 6M -49.9%
supporting_l_codes.note: EXCLUSION clause 2/4 (sector-neutralized + multi-sleeve context) 만족 불구 실패 — EXCLUSION이 necessary not sufficient condition임을 empirical 실증

independence.rationale: 3건이 서로 다른 factor family (distress+calmar / multi-source 4-axis / Q07 sector-neutral 2-axis), factor construction 독립. 단, 모두 defense role + long-only top-20이라는 공통 constraint 하에 있음 — 완전 독립 아님

repeatability.rationale: 3건 모두 동일 signature (ICIR strong → MDD 58~95% catastrophic) 명확 재현. 4건의 STR_1685 variant 내부에서도 4/4 재현. Perfect repeatability.

family_consistency.rationale: 3건 모두 defense/core_secondary single-sleeve long-only top-20 공통 constraint, signature 일관성 90%. L-166이 EXCLUSION clause 2/4 만족에도 동일 결과 → family extension 강화

explainability.rationale: 4가지 structural cause 식별 (concentration, idio cluster, hedging absence, ICIR-drawdown decoupling). 그러나 정확한 empirical threshold (50+ 분산? 30+ 분산?) 추가 측정 필요

mechanism_clarity.rationale: IC-Return coupling 수식화(SR/ICIR ratio), poison_pill definition (IC>0 + SR<0.8 + MDD>35%), Bali-Cakici-Whitelaw (2011) tail risk 이론 연결 명확

empirical_evidence_summary.total_variant_count: STR_1683 4 variants + STR_1685 4 variants + STR_1687 1 = 9 portfolio executions

policy_implications.judge_gate_13_rule: Signal-Portfolio Translation Failure 자동 탐지: ICIR>0.3 AND SR<0.8 AND MDD>35% AND role in [defense, core_secondary] AND single_sleeve_long_only → auto-flag and MANDATORY rejection
policy_implications.judge_gate_12_l163_poison_pill: L-160 STR_1683이 poison_pill definition origin. Gate 12 MANDATORY rule 집행 강화
policy_implications.governor_pg1_admission_rule: Defense single-sleeve long-only top-20 admission 차단 (AX-007 scope 명시). multi-sleeve blend 내 sleeve 구성 시에만 admission 고려.
policy_implications.scout_s0_design_rule: Defense/Core_Secondary 단독 long-only 20종목 가설 설계 시 AX-007 scope 명시 + EXCLUSION 조건(long-short 또는 50+ 분산) 명시 필수. S0 debate에서 Codex critic이 violation flag
policy_implications.forge_code_guard: restart_block 활성화 — AX-007 scope 내 재실행 차단

quarterly_review.review_criteria: 추가 family member 확인 시 confidence 상승, EXCLUSION clause 4-attribute 수정 가능성 검토, multi-sleeve blend 내 defense sleeve가 family scope 밖임을 재확인

relationship_to_existing_axioms.ax_005_relationship: AX-005 (KR defense standalone long-only 실패)는 low-beta/Q07+D25 combo/4-axis composite scope. AX-007은 SIGNAL-PORTFOLIO translation 메커니즘에 focus. 상호 보완 — AX-005는 family specific, AX-007은 mechanism general
relationship_to_existing_axioms.ax_005_v1_2_extension: AX-005 supporting_l_codes에 L-166 편입 권고 (L-136+L-140+L-165+L-166 4건) + confidence 0.90 → 0.94
relationship_to_existing_axioms.ax_006_pairwise_tdc_relationship: AX-006 (pairwise TDC, EXTEND Q3 0.67)는 cross-strategy similarity 관리. AX-007은 single-strategy translation failure. 독립 track
